DWG support — LibreDWG compiled to WebAssembly (@mlightcad/libredwg-web 0.7.17)
https://github.com/mlightcad/libredwg-web · https://www.gnu.org/software/libredwg/

License: GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0). See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.html

This folder is loaded only when a .dwg file is opened. If you do not want
GPL-licensed code in your site, delete this whole "libredwg" folder:
everything else keeps working, and DWG files can still be used after
saving them as DXF in AutoCAD (or with the free ODA File Converter).
If you publish the site with this folder, publish it under GPL-3.0
terms (keep the code public and include this notice).
